nodes.label: Driver Error Mapping (MappedError)
nodes.author: Tyler Benfield
nodes.rationale: Errors must be wrapped in DriverAdapterError with proper MappedError kinds so Prisma handles constraint violations correctly.

nodes.label: SqlDriverAdapter
nodes.author: Tyler Benfield
nodes.rationale: Critical contract details not inferable from code examples; existing implementations do not replace this skill.

nodes.label: Transaction Lifecycle Protocol (hooks only)
nodes.author: Tyler Benfield
nodes.rationale: commit()/rollback() are lifecycle hooks only and must NOT issue SQL - Prisma sends COMMIT/ROLLBACK via executeRaw on the transaction object.

nodes.label: Driver Adapters
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: No native engine binary, smaller bundle size, better serverless/edge compatibility, native Node.js drivers, more control over connection pooling; required for SQL providers in v7.

nodes.label: Explicit Environment Loading
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: v7 CLI no longer auto-loads .env files; dotenv (or Bun auto-load) must be imported manually, first in prisma.config.ts.

nodes.label: MongoDB v7 Exclusion Rule
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Prisma 7 has no MongoDB connector and no published @prisma/adapter-* package for MongoDB; Mongo projects stay on latest 6.x or migrate to Prisma Next instead of the SQL adapter path.

nodes.label: prisma-client Generator
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Default generator in v7; prisma-client-js remains only for legacy setups; enables explicit output paths, multiple entrypoints, and TS-native generated code.

nodes.label: prisma.config.ts
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Central CLI configuration file replacing .env+schema-based config; holds schema path, migrations path/seed, and datasource URLs.

nodes.label: MongoDB Driver Session Transactions
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Multi-document atomicity works today via client.startSession()/session.withTransaction(...) on a replica set since mongodb is a user-supplied peer dependency.

nodes.label: mongoRaw(...) Raw Lane
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Replaces v6 $runCommandRaw/findRaw/aggregateRaw which have no Next-side names; arbitrary database commands go through the underlying mongodb driver.

nodes.label: Collection Storage Name Addressing (db.orm.users)
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: ORM keys are collection storage names (@@map name or lowercased model name), not model names - the most common porting mistake.

nodes.label: Stay-on-v6 Hygiene
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Staying is a decision, not default-by-neglect: pin latest 6.x, track advisories, keep classic db push setup, re-evaluate at GA.

nodes.label: Prisma Next Migration Lifecycle (emit/diff/plan/migrate/verify/sign)
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: DDL is not transactional on Mongo; the runner verifies live schema against the destination contract before advancing the marker, making runs resumable rather than atomic.

nodes.label: v6 MongoDB db push Workflow
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: v6 MongoDB explicitly has no Prisma Migrate because MongoDB projects do not rely on internal schemas; no migration history on disk.

nodes.label: Prisma Next Contract Model
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: schema.prisma becomes a contract (PSL or TS builder); mechanical translation produces contracts that fail verification or silently change collection addressing.

nodes.label: Staged Read-only Soak and Code Rollback
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.norm_label: staged read-only soak and code rollback

nodes.label: Prisma Next Mongo Facade Transactions Gap
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.norm_label: prisma next mongo facade transactions gap
nodes.rationale: Next Mongo facade does not wrap db.transaction yet; atomicity goes through the underlying mongodb driver session API until the wrapper lands.

nodes.label: Prisma Next
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Successor path for MongoDB projects: Early Access support, GA planned after Postgres; team wants early adopter feedback.

nodes.label: client-api-mapping
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Names map, parity does not: v6 raw methods do not exist under old names, aggregation moved lanes, assuming parity breaks compilation or loses atomicity silently.

nodes.label: decision-stay-or-migrate
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Advising an impossible v7 upgrade or silently rewriting onto SQL are serious failure modes; migrate to Next is encouraged, stay on v6 deliberately where hard blockers apply.

nodes.label: verify-cutover-checklist
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: A v6 to Next migration is a client/workflow migration against the same database - data never moves; introducing data movement turns a code migration into an outage.

nodes.label: Prisma MongoDB Upgrade Path Skill
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Never advise upgrading MongoDB projects to Prisma 7 (connector does not exist); never solve by rewriting onto SQL.

nodes.label: Hand-off Rule (discovery bridge)
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: This skill is the discovery bridge, not a replacement for Prisma Next docs; after switching, follow Prisma Next's own skills day-to-day.

nodes.label: No MongoDB Connector in Prisma 7
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: v6 is the terminal classic-ORM major for MongoDB; v7 never ships a MongoDB connector, making general v7 upgrade advice impossible.

nodes.label: Serverless Driver Choice (@prisma/adapter-ppg)
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Standard Node.js apps prefer @prisma/adapter-pg over direct TCP; the serverless driver only when specifically needed for edge/serverless runtimes.

nodes.label: Structured endpoints.direct/pooled Objects
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Flat top-level connectionString is deprecated in favor of endpoints.direct.connectionString/endpoints.pooled.connectionString.

nodes.label: Prisma Service Tokens
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Workspace-scoped server-to-server auth; token shown only once at creation; store in env vars or secret managers, never source code; rotate periodically.

nodes.label: Direct Connection String (endpoints.direct)
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Use the direct endpoint; pooled and accelerate endpoints are legacy Accelerate setups not needed for new projects.

nodes.label: prisma.config.ts Connection Config
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: Prisma 7 manages connection URLs in prisma.config.ts, never in schema.prisma; dotenv/config must be imported there.

nodes.label: Adapter-Mandatory Client Rule
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.rationale: new PrismaClient() with no arguments throws and datasourceUrl does not exist in Prisma 7; a driver adapter must be passed explicitly at runtime.

nodes.label: Source-of-Truth Order for Editing and Running
nodes.author: prisma
nodes.norm_label: source-of-truth order for editing and running

nodes.label: JWT Utilities (src/modules/auth/jwt.ts)
nodes.rationale: JWT TTL 24 hours; algorithm pinned to HS256 (algorithms: ['HS256']) to prevent algorithm-confusion; jti generated via crypto.randomUUID().

nodes.label: One-Time Login Code (60s TTL)
nodes.rationale: SELECT + DELETE makes code single-use; 60-second TTL limits replay window.

nodes.label: DataFlow Auth Pattern (one-time code -> JWT Bearer)
nodes.norm_label: dataflow auth pattern (one-time code -> jwt bearer)
nodes.rationale: Google OAuth redirect yields short-lived one-time login code exchanged for JWT stored in localStorage; CSRF mitigated via httpOnly oauth_state cookie (SameSite=Lax); JWT TTL 24h.

nodes.label: JTI Token Revocation (revoked_tokens)
nodes.rationale: Per-token logout: jti extracted from JWT and inserted into revoked_tokens; checked on every authenticated request so a logged-out JWT becomes 401 immediately.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern (Database-Agnostic)
nodes.rationale: Adopted due to risk of future PostgreSQL -> BigQuery migration; business logic must never use Prisma directly, all DB queries go through interfaces, no raw SQL in services, Prisma-specific code isolated in repository implementations.

nodes.label: Removed CLI Flags and Automatic Behaviors
nodes.norm_label: removed cli flags and automatic behaviors

nodes.label: accelerateUrl Client Setup
nodes.rationale: Driver adapters expect direct connection strings and fail with prisma:// or prisma+postgres:// URLs; accelerateUrl preserves the Accelerate proxy path.

nodes.label: Adapter Connection Pool Configuration
nodes.rationale: Adapters use underlying driver pool defaults that differ from v6; max/idleTimeoutMillis/connectionTimeoutMillis set explicitly (v6 used a 5s connection timeout).

nodes.label: globalThis Prisma Singleton Pattern
nodes.rationale: Caches PrismaClient on globalThis outside production so dev hot-reload does not exhaust database connections.

nodes.label: Adapter SSL Configuration
nodes.rationale: SSL cert handling moves to the adapter; rejectUnauthorized:false preserves old self-signed behavior, CA certs via ssl.ca or NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.

nodes.label: Manual dotenv Loading
nodes.rationale: v7 removed automatic .env loading by the CLI; import dotenv/config must be the first import in prisma.config.ts; Bun loads .env automatically.

nodes.label: CommonJS moduleFormat Fallback
nodes.rationale: moduleFormat=cjs in the generator lets still-CommonJS apps adopt v7 without forcing an entire-app ESM migration.

nodes.label: ESM-first Module Format
nodes.rationale: v7 generates ESM by default; package.json type=module and tsconfig module/moduleResolution must agree with the generator's moduleFormat to avoid ERR_REQUIRE_ESM.

nodes.label: Client Extensions ($extends)
nodes.rationale: Typed query/client extension API replacing $use() middleware for interception patterns such as logging, soft delete, and custom metric counters.

nodes.label: TypeScript satisfies Replaces Prisma.validator()
nodes.rationale: The prisma-client generator no longer exposes Prisma.validator; the TypeScript satisfies operator provides equivalent type-safe query fragment validation.

nodes.label: Schema Datasource URL Deprecation
nodes.rationale: url/directUrl/shadowDatabaseUrl move out of schema.prisma into prisma.config.ts so only provider remains in the schema.

nodes.label: Required Generator Output Path
nodes.rationale: With prisma-client, output is mandatory because the client no longer generates into node_modules; imports must point at the generated directory.
